subject: general
question:
How many rectangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18893b7512e63fa13c67bde17d675e8330d59ec991d680fa879a60a423292e55.png]
solution:
The number of rectangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of rectangles = ( (2×(2+1))/(2))×((3×(3+1))/(2))) = ( (2×3)/(2))×((3×4)/(2)) = ( (6)/(2))×((12)/(2)) = 3 × 6 ⇒18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cda71127d4ad5419e10c21aa088203f97e4e926c61df3e07a648b03f82da9684.png] 

 

2) Total number of rectangles = 13 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9132bbb6af67df58815f627897e91ac4ddc0f5d12b8e36a0eead2042ffffdcb1.png] 

As marked, there are a total of (18 + 13) = 31 rectangles.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**__Formula used:__

Number of rectangles = ( (n×(n+1))/(2))×((m×(m+1))/(2))

Where,

number of rows = n

number of columns = m
